title: People's Republic of Bulgaria
capsule: The People's Republic of Bulgaria was the communist state established after the September 1944 Soviet-backed coup that ousted the pro-German monarchy, with a new constitution formalizing one-party rule under the Bulgarian Communist Party in 1947. Under Todor Zhivkov, who consolidated power by 1954 and led the country until 1989, Bulgaria was among the Soviet Union's most loyal Warsaw Pact members, industrializing rapidly but also conducting a forced assimilation campaign against the Turkish minority in 1984–1985 that drove some 300,000 ethnic Turks to emigrate. The regime collapsed peacefully in November 1989 when Zhivkov was ousted by Communist reformers amid the wider Eastern Bloc revolutions, and Bulgaria adopted a new democratic constitution in 1991, formally ending the People's Republic.
